skill.name: brand-guidelines
skill.usageExample: 帮我做一套 AI 产品的品牌视觉规范，包含颜色、字体、按钮和常用组件，整理成一页清晰的规范图。

description.zh: 将 Anthropic 官方品牌色与字体规范应用到任何需要 Anthropic 视觉风格的产出物上。当涉及品牌色或样式规范、视觉排版、公司设计标准时使用。
description.en: Applies Anthropic's official brand colors and typography to any sort of artifact that may benefit from having Anthropic's look-and-feel. Use it when brand colors or style guidelines, visual formatting, or company design standards apply.
